# models.dev V2 regression fixture

`models-dev-v2.json` is the OpenAI provider header and GPT Image 2.5 Flare entry selected from the live `https://models.dev/experimental/v2.0/api.json` response fetched on 2026-10-29. Other test entries are synthetic clones used to exercise identity collisions, filters and overrides; tests never access the network.

Contract checked against models.dev commit `5022ebfadda67ba58cfa55f359a231e392a0f6fb`:

- [V1 exclusion](https://github.com/anomalyco/models.dev/blob/5022ebfadda67ba58cfa55f359a231e392a0f6fb/packages/core/src/generate.ts#L150-L151)
- [V2 generation / inheritance](https://github.com/anomalyco/models.dev/blob/5022ebfadda67ba58cfa55f359a231e392a0f6fb/packages/core/src/generate-v2.ts#L46-L185)
- [Published schema and prices](https://github.com/anomalyco/models.dev/blob/5022ebfadda67ba58cfa55f359a231e392a0f6fb/packages/core/src/schema-v2.ts)

The published response already resolves `base_model`, overrides and `base_model_omit`; `canonical_id` records provenance, not the invocation ID. Capabilities are nested; modalities include MIME subtypes. Internal `Model` has no model-type field: existing outputs derive image/audio labels from normalized modalities, not a new public type field.

Import policy: preserve V1 provider fields and complete models on identical provider/model keys, supplement absent keys before local overrides and native filtering. Separate raw caches (`api.json`, `api-v2.json`) prevent V2 additions from becoming stale V1 winners. Failure without a usable cache fails loading; cache fallback is visibly logged.

This change imports V2 metadata only. V2 prices have modality-specific units, conditional overrides, multipliers and cache TTL maps that are not the V1 flat cost contract. They are deliberately omitted with catalog/build warnings, never flattened or inferred from model type. Existing local cost overrides remain supported. Metadata survives unsupported or absent pricing. V1 pricing is unchanged.

Run `npm test` (Node's built-in test runner; no pre-existing test framework was configured). Output JSON paths and NewAPI model fields are unchanged. Translation memory is not generated by these tests: descriptions still use the existing en/zh/ja fallback/override logic.
